title: Joins and the meaning of a result row
brief: Construct a result whose rows mean exactly what the question requires.
outcomes: Predict row multiplication and missing matches
Build a correct still-due report and absence test
entry: Introductory JOIN, GROUP BY and NULL; keys and value semantics.

title: Updates, upserts and bulk imports
brief: Make each change conditional and each imported conflict a domain decision.
outcomes: Use affected rows to enforce a write precondition
Stage, validate and reconcile a replayable batch
entry: Keys, constraints, transaction atomicity and the mug update.

neighbours.RL93: Owns request identity after ambiguous commit.

title: Replicas, lag and read routing
brief: Route reads from the freshness and failure promises each copy can meet.
outcomes: Distinguish received, durable and replayed progress
Design read-your-write routing and account for lag and retention
entry: Commit durability and application request identity.

title: Reading and repairing PostgreSQL plans
brief: Repair a PostgreSQL plan using measured cardinality, work and workload stability.
outcomes: Interpret EXPLAIN ANALYZE without mistaking its counters
Test statistics, access paths and prepared-plan repairs under skew
entry: General execution plans and PostgreSQL storage/index methods.

title: PostgreSQL roles, policies and privileged code
brief: Test PostgreSQL privilege and row-policy boundaries as the actual application roles.
outcomes: Explain role inheritance, ownership and policy bypass
Secure privileged routines against identity and name-resolution mistakes
entry: General least privilege and tenant boundaries (RL104), including application connection ownership. The needed secure deployment, SQL object names and session identity are introduced locally.

title: Where distributed PostgreSQL work runs
brief: Choose where PostgreSQL-distributed work runs from co-location, constraint scope and movement requirements.
outcomes: Distinguish native partitions, application shards, Citus and foreign tables
Derive local work, skew and a safe ownership transfer
entry: General sharding, distributed transactions and PostgreSQL architecture.
